text: hm. interesting. so some of these im going to contest. for example. the dumpster, you say it is exact, ok. so if i look at images of dumpsters you can fit like 2-3 people inside of [Image #1] [Image #2] but look at the game [Image #3] thats why all the sizes feel all wrong. i mean i disagree with every single one of them tbh
resolution: User contested the real-world audit (every verdict) using dumpster reference photos vs the game render. Verified they are right, found and documented two compounding causes: (1) wrong yardstick — the audit compared absolute meters, but perceived size is the prop/player ratio; props carry real meters while the player is stylized-tall 2.01m vs real 1.75m, so the ENTIRE catalog renders at ~87% of real presence (trees 37-44%, streetLight 65%); (2) model honesty — the dumpster model normalizes by AUTHORED_HEIGHT=1.2 but its parts only reach ~1.05 of that, rendering ~1.18m vs the 1.35m registry, with depth 0.96m vs real 1.37m (half the interior volume — why 2-3 people fit in a real one and barely 1 in ours); FireHydrant/Fence verified honest, ~15 models unaudited, dumpster part tables duplicated between Dumpster.tsx and worldGeometry.ts (rule-of-two). Corrected presence table + proposed x1.15 registry targets written into docs/game/_reports/PROP-REALWORLD-AUDIT.md. No code changed — the 54-kind sweep awaits the user's ruling on the x1.15 law and tree band.
